problem.title: You didn't start a studio to do admin.
problem.body1: You started it to teach. But somewhere between the term invoices, the paper registers, the parent emails and a website still showing last year's timetable, the admin quietly ate your week.
problem.body2: Olune pulls all of it into one place — and quietly does the heavy lifting in the background, so your evenings stop belonging to the paperwork.

pricingSection.title: Fair pricing.
pricingSection.subtitle: One plan replaces your class manager, your accounting app and your website builder. Pay for one thing, not four.

solo.name: Solo
solo.desc: Everything you need to teach, take the roll and get fees paid. For the studio that's one person.

studio.name: Studio
studio.desc: Everything in Solo, plus staff, substitutes, enrolment forms and your studio website — what starts mattering once there's a team.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Every module Olune has, including private lessons, badges and progress, production and costumes.

pricingSection.includesBody: unlimited students, enrolments and timetabling, attendance, invoicing and payments, and free updates. No setup fees, ever.
pricingSection.honestMathBody: Most studio software charges by student count, so the bill grows every time you have a good term. Every Olune plan has unlimited students — the price only changes if you decide you want more of Olune.

money.title: Stay on top of the money
money.subtitle: Term invoices, payment plans, and card or bank payments built right in. Watch what has come in and what is still owed, in real time.

liveSites.title: Keep your website live
liveSites.subtitle: Your timetable, classes and prices on a site you edit yourself — published the moment you change it. No developer, no waiting.

runClasses.title: Run the classes
runClasses.subtitle: Every class, enrolment, register and family in one clear view. Know who is in, who is away, and who still has not enrolled for next term.

aboutSection.title: Built by studio people,
aboutSection.body1: We've run studios. We know the 11pm invoice scramble, the register that never made it back to the office, the website still showing last year's timetable.
aboutSection.body2: So we built the thing we wished we had — one calm system that holds the classes, the families, the money and the website, and keeps them all in step.
aboutSection.body3: Olune exists for one reason: to give studio people their time back. Less admin. More teaching. That's the whole idea.

compareSection.subtitle: Most studios run on a patchwork — a class manager here, an accounting app there, a separate website builder, and a spreadsheet holding it all together.
